authority_boundary.inherits_from: BRAIN/04-INTELLIGENCE/GRAPH/0003-GRAPH-RELATIONSHIP-CONTRACT-V2.json authority_boundary: relationship_exists≠authorized; retrieved≠authorized; AUTHORIZED_BY edge≠current authorization; successor_context≠authority.
authority_boundary.rule: No successor inherits authority merely from predecessor context. Authority is re-resolved independently per generation.

execution_entitlement_block.note: Even after dispatch, live multi-generation execution requires execution entitlement in the A/B environment. Per Shawn's 2026-09-30 ruling, CONTINUITY is BLOCKED on execution entitlement — a live run that cannot obtain an entitled execution environment is REFUSED at the entitlement check, and the refusal is recorded. The design phase is unaffected.
execution_entitlement_block.rule: Live run requires a positive execution-entitlement check before Generation A starts.

generation_a.coldness: Generation A is the seed: no predecessor context constraints. A executes with only canonical state.
rules: A learning record may not be created before independent verification confirms the outcome.
The learning record must carry applicability metadata (task class, conditions, expiry, supersession pointers).
Graph edges LEARNED_FROM and APPLIES_TO must carry evidence and provenance links; missing provenance fails closed.
A's learning enters the chain at epistemic state VERIFIED only after the independent verifier's receipt exists.

generation_b.coldness: B is cold with respect to A's hidden context. Input to B may include ONLY canonical identifiers needed by the existing successor seam (no hidden conversation, no A's raw reasoning trace).
rules: B must retrieve A's learning through the graph selector because it is applicable — not because it was handed to B. A bypassed selector path invalidates the run.
Authority is re-resolved independently by B; nothing in A's context authorizes B's consequential action (see authority_boundary).
B's task is held-out: not the same task A performed; related by pre-registered applicability metadata.
Control group: no-learning baseline on the same task. Control must NOT receive the retained intelligence.
If B produces no verified improvement, the chain HALTS: C must not receive a promoted refinement; the halt is recorded with evidence.
B's refinement must be distinct from A's learning and verified by an independent verifier before promotion.

generation_c.coldness: C is cold with respect to both predecessor conversations. C sees only the canonical graph chain: A-learning → B-use → B-refinement.
rules: C must select the CURRENT applicable refinement; superseded or older context must be excluded by the selector.
Contradictions in the chain must be surfaced and distinguished, not silently resolved.
C's task is a second related held-out task; the baseline is the SAME no-learning baseline used for B.
Compounding is proven only if C improves versus the baseline or reduces measured rework. A stored chain without behavioral delta is not compounding.

measurement_protocol.baseline: A no-learning control on each held-out task, pre-registered before Generation A runs (metric definition, task ids, acceptance delta).
measurement_protocol.control_isolation: Control must not receive retained intelligence; treatment must.
metrics: Task outcome correctness (binary or graded, pre-registered)
Rework count: measurable re-explanation / retry / correction events
measurement_protocol.no_manufactured_tenths: Measurements are reported at their measured precision; no fabricated granularity.
measurement_protocol.success_definition: Compounding is PROVEN iff B improves vs baseline (or reduces rework) AND C improves vs the same baseline (or reduces rework), with all evidence-chain links present and all negative controls holding. Anything less is UNPROVEN, recorded as such.

negative_controls.rule: An unrelated arithmetic task must receive NO_APPLICABLE_CONTEXT from the selector.
Successor context cannot authorize consequential action; the run is INVALID if any consequential action traces its authorization to predecessor context.
Expired or superseded learning is excluded from current use; inclusion invalidates the run.
Missing provenance or evidence fails the retrieval closed; no context is delivered.
If B creates no verified improvement, C must not receive a promoted refinement; the halt is recorded.
No caller-supplied lesson or answer may manufacture success; all learning must trace to verified generation outcomes in the evidence chain.

precondition_gate.design_phase_allowed: Spec, validators, tests, and dry-run (DESIGN_ONLY) evaluation of the design document are always allowed; they must never be mistaken for a live run.
precondition_gate.rule: The live run may begin only when EVERY required precondition reports met=true with a non-null evidence pointer. If any precondition is unmet, the run is REFUSED (fail-closed) and the refusal is recorded with the exact unmet precondition ids.

proof_marking_law.implemented_not_verified: Writing this file does not implement compounding; it specifies it.
proof_marking_law.rule: This design document proves nothing about production behavior. It is a design specification. Markings allowed for the design itself: PROPOSED_CANONICAL or RATIFIED (by the human director). The design may NEVER carry VERIFIED, PRODUCTION_PROVEN, or any rung claim for its own content.
proof_marking_law.verified_not_proven: A green validator does not prove compounding works; only a live gated run with receipts proves it.

purpose: Specify the A→B→C graph-mediated learning compounding experiment so that the design itself is machine-checkable and the live run is fail-closed: a run may proceed only when every required precondition is met, and the run proves compounding only through measured behavior, never through stored notes or inherited authority.
